note: V12-S1 (PLAN.md amendment 2), hypotheses D and C: a short low-learning-rate second stage after R1's acquisition stage. From R1 (pack eb7ec595..., content 9909c511...), lr 3e-5 (R4's retaining rate) warmup-stable-decay, one epoch of: the 93 string-literal bug fixes round 54's mix lacks (basics.literal_bugfix_examples, 3 per bug) plus a 50% token share of uniform replay from round 54's production mix (data seed 1302, R1's). No new curriculum. Screened on dev + unseen-v1 first; the other sets only if the screen reaches the gate's score. Dry run before launch: 33,990 tokens (literal bug fixes 11,338 = 93 examples; production replay 21,503 = 273 examples; original replay 1,149), training split 32,481 tokens -> 7 steps.
